name: Screenbox
tagline: Fluent Design 开源播放器，基于 LibVLC 全格式硬解
taglineEn: Fluent Design open-source player with LibVLC hardware decoding
description: 一款专为 Windows 10/11 设计的开源媒体播放器，界面采用微软 Fluent Design 设计语言，底层基于 LibVLC，解码能力强，支持 4K / HDR / AV1 等格式硬解，观感和 Win11 系统界面统一，放视频很舒服。
descriptionEn: An open-source media player designed for Windows 10/11 with a Fluent Design interface and LibVLC underneath. It has strong decoding support including 4K, HDR and AV1 hardware decoding, and blends in with the Windows 11 interface.
author: huynhsontung

downloads.platform: 通过 Microsoft Store 下载
